text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perubatan Tradisional

dan Komplementari (Penetapan Badan Pengamal) (Pindaan) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 16 Disember 2021.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Perubatan Tradisional dan Komplementari (Penetapan Badan

Pengamal) 2020 [P.U. (A) 74/2020], dipinda dalam teks bahasa Inggeris, dalam

ruang (1) Jadual, dengan menggantikan butiran "Malaysian Medical Homeopathic

Council" dengan butiran "Malaysian Homeopathy Medical Council".

Dibuat 6 April 2023

[KKM.S.600-1/3/357/PN(PU2)734]

 DR. ZALIHA BINTI MUSTAFA

 Menteri Kesihatan

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE ACT 2016

TRADITIONAL AND COMPLEMENTARY MEDICINE

(DESIGNATION OF PRACTITIONER BODY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 42(1) of

the Traditional and Complementary Medicine Act 2016 [Act 775], the Minister,

on the recommendation of the Council, makes the following order:
